script: I told him I knew nothing—until he threatened to expose my secret.. I was at the garden center, scrolling through the catalog, when this 80‑year‑old Italian guy—let's call him Vito—walked up. He'd just got his medical card for cannabis, and he was like, "Tell me how to grow weed, right now." I didn't even have a single plant in my life, so I am like, "Bruh, I can't school you on growing cannabis. I've never even done it." He wasn't having it. "You work here. You know plants. You have to give me the full, inside‑out guide." I tried to explain, "I can show you how to start tomatoes, prune roses—those are my skills. Growing weed is a whole other ball game." But Vito was like, "I have a medical card. I am not asking for a hobby. I need the whole process, step by step." I was like, "Look, I don't have the knowledge base. Get a book." (Picture this: mid‑90s, no internet, no smartphones, just a dusty library of gardening manuals.) He didn't take it. He was like, "That's not the job of a store clerk." I thought, "I am better than this. I am not going to teach a bunch of old men how to grow illegal stuff." So I just gave him a polite, "You can find a guide online. I can't help." He left, fuming. I didn't bother him again. I still love tomatoes. I just didn't have the weed IQ. (I mean, seriously, who's teaching an 80‑year‑old how to grow cannabis when you've never even touched a seed?)
